findings.memoryIndicator: The old performance.memory reading is cached/bucketized and not a live pure-JS-heap curve. Device precise counters change while the old field stays fixed, including after close. Chromium source corroborates external-inclusive accounting and a 20-minute bucketized cache; the exact installed156 source tag was not retrieved.
findings.memoryOwnership: Private snapshot paths identify live AssetManager font bytes, native provider borrows, a shared-face comparison buffer, raster/Host residence, saved readback and CanvasKit WASM storage. Twenty matched replacement cycles show bounded values in this profile; retirement/close and physical memory remain different claims.
findings.cadence: Historical41.4ms trigger was not reproduced in either backend, including the exact original45-action warm-up. The historical sample and uncertainty remain; no renderer or refresh-rate workaround was introduced.
findings.correction: Measurement interpretation and evidence documentation; no confirmed engine defect was patched
